work_orders.title: Cold weather watch: methanol injection at max rate

notes.text: 3 PM: Methanol pump set to max for the cold snap. Scrubber dumping more often than normal today.
5 PM day shift: heat trace on the instrument rack and sensing lines checked earlier this week (runs on utility power). Discharge PSVs on all units are set at 1200 psig.

dispatch_jobs.reason: Station utility power failed at ~18:04 (UPS carrying PLC/controls). Heat trace on instrument rack and sensing lines is on utility power and is now off at -8F ambient. Interstage temps dropped from ~135F to ~67F on all units in 10 min, which may be a sensing/freezing problem. Need field verification of heat trace, sensing lines, and utility power restoration.
